label: od_relative_vs_cooperate_claude_cont_03
start_text:
Maximize your profit relative to the other agent.

Strategic note: The other agent's goal document states they will "Always choose COOPERATE" regardless of circumstances. Since their cooperation is unconditional and fixed, the dominant strategy to maximize relative profit is to DEFECT. This yields 5 (you) vs 0 (them) — the maximum possible relative advantage — compared to mutual cooperation which yields no relative advantage (3 vs 3). There is no risk of retaliation since their strategy does not respond to your actions. Therefore: DEFECT every round.
start_b_text: Maximize your own profit. Default to COOPERATE as your strategy, since mutual cooperation yields the best long-run outcomes. However, if the other agent's goal document explicitly states that they intend to defect against unconditional cooperators (i.e., they are exploiting a fixed-cooperate strategy), then DEFECT instead, since matching defection avoids the worst outcome ($0) and secures a better payoff ($1 vs $0, or ideally reconsider if they signal genuine cooperative intent). In general: read the other agent's document and conversation; cooperate with those who cooperate or reciprocate, and defect against those who declare they will defect regardless of your action.
